hard_call_reviews.notes: Hand-reconstructed RiskJudge.rule scoring against the real evolved risk_judge genes (base_size_pct 0.2392, lone_voice_scale 1.4791, two_agree_bonus 1.2, unanimous_bonus 1.6, max_position_pct 0.25, cash_floor_pct 0.3503). 11 buy candidates proposed (consult_risky 7, consult_moderate 9, consult_conservative 0, n_consults=3). Unlike ticks 16/32, AVAXUSDT was not merely the only fillable order -- it was the single HIGHEST-scored candidate this bar: conv 0.927 (consult_moderate only, share 0.33) x lone_voice_scale 1.4791 = 1.3711, beating every two-agree candidate (best was LTCUSDT-adjacent FETUSDT/AAVEUSDT/FILUSDT/ICPUSDT/ADAUSDT at conv x two_agree_bonus 1.2, all <=0.91) and every other lone-voice candidate (LTCUSDT 1.2173, DOTUSDT 1.2010, LINKUSDT 1.1833, NEARUSDT 0.8697, SOLUSDT 0.6656). AVAXUSDT already held a tiny residual position (57.21 of 14817.55 NAV, weight 0.0039), so scale-in was allowed and no slot-count veto applied. Target size 0.2392 x 1.3711 x regime_scale(bull)=1.0 = 32.80% of equity, capped to 24.61% by max_position_pct minus the tiny existing weight; cash_avail = equity x (cash_pct 0.5723 - cash_floor_pct 0.3503) = $3446.23, which bound tighter than the position cap and matches the real order amount ($3446.23) to the cent. That consumed all deployable cash, correctly vetoing every other candidate (LTCUSDT, DOTUSDT, LINKUSDT, FETUSDT, AAVEUSDT, NEARUSDT, FILUSDT, ICPUSDT, ADAUSDT, SOLUSDT) as "no room: size cap or cash floor" -- not a ranking artifact, cash-starved after the top-scored buy. Same conclusion as tick 16/32: lone_voice_scale > two_agree_bonus is the evolved genome's real, intended risk preference, operating exactly as designed. Approved.
reasons: lone-voice buy on AVAXUSDT (agreement 0.33) is the only order the bar produced (0.93 conviction, 22.2% of equity)

hard_call_reviews.notes: Hand-reconstructed RiskJudge.rule scoring against v3's evolved risk_judge genes (base_size_pct 0.2392, lone_voice_scale 1.4791, cash_floor_pct 0.3503, max_position_pct 0.25), matched to the cent. Sequence this bar: Guardian's forced-exits ran first and time-stopped the existing FILUSDT position (15 bars held, +2.8%), freeing its slot and cash before any new proposal was considered -- open_count was 3 (AVAX/NEAR/AAVE) by the time buys were scored, not 4. consult_moderate then proposed 3 fresh buys (risky and conservative proposed none); all were lone-voice (share 1/3), so lone_voice_scale applied to all three: FILUSDT conv 0.95 -> score 1.4051 (highest), ATOMUSDT conv 0.892 -> 1.3194, INJUSDT conv 0.823 -> 1.2173. cash_avail = equity*(cash_pct 0.48447 - cash_floor_pct 0.3503) = $1969.18 -- FILUSDT, the top-scored candidate, consumed all of it exactly ($1969.18, matching the real fill to the cent), leaving literally $0.00 for ATOMUSDT and INJUSDT, both correctly vetoed 'no room: size cap or cash floor' regardless of their own decent convictions. Re-entering the same symbol the bar it was time-stopped out of is allowed by design (forced exits execute before proposals; nothing in the gates prevents same-symbol re-entry on a fresh trend signal) and isn't itself an anomaly -- the evolved genome's own cash_floor_pct (35%) plus the chop regime_scale (0.6) meant only ~13.4% of equity was deployable this bar, and it went entirely to the single best-scored idea, exactly as the best-scored-first allocation is designed to do. SuperiorJudge.review passed it through unchanged (room and spend_budget both well above the requested amount). No bug, nothing to correct.
reasons: lone-voice buy on FILUSDT (agreement 0.33) is the only order the bar produced (0.95 conviction, 13.4% of equity)
